mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand weakness that triggers equity sell-offs as corporate revenue expectations decline, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either HOUST or RSAFS declines individually, or joint decline produces negative returns in less than 40% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 110) and stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 3.0% YoY), supply chain constraints ease, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real consumer spending (RSAFS) signals strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, it signals persistent inflation that triggers a hawkish monetary policy response, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signals a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when either PAYEMS declines or UNRATE rises individually, or joint behavior produces negative returns in less than 40% of cases over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high monetary policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the central bank's focus on inflation control leads to a risk-off environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
